data.action: 提着草帽散步，晚风拂过裙摆
data.description: 夕阳西下的清凉河畔草坡上，塞西莉亚提着草帽赤脚踩在柔软的浅草间，晚风吹拂着她轻盈的白色长裙。她转过身拉住你的手，翠绿眼眸中映着整片晚霞——「镇上的人们都说圣女带来了奇迹……但对我而言，能遇到劳伦斯才是世界上最棒的奇迹。」
data.promptProse: Cecilia walks barefoot along the riverbank, straw hat in one hand and the other linked with Lawrence's. Her mint-green hair and ankle-length white sundress catch the gold light, while Lawrence's short dark hair and charcoal pastor's coat are in profile beside her. The full-body view includes their joined hands and the evening water behind them.
data.title: 塞西莉亚 · 河畔黄昏散步
data.animaCaption: Barefoot Cecilia carries the straw hat in one hand and takes Lawrence's hand with the other. Lawrence has short dark hair and a dark pastor's coat; her white sundress moves in the river breeze beside him.
